Rahi, Javaid (Ed.). Gojri Dictionary (Multi-volume & Concise editions). Jammu: Jammu & Kashmir Academy of Art, Culture and Languages (JKAACL).

entries.notes: Classic masculine noun in -o, showing typical Gojri nominal inflection.
definitions: Equus caballus, domesticated odd-toed ungulate mammal widely kept by Gujjars for transportation in hilly terrain.

entries.notes: Feminine pair to ghoṛo, formed with suffix -i.

example_sentence.text: بکرو چراگاہ ماں چر رہیو ہے
example_sentence.text_devanagari: बकरो चरागाह माँ चर रहियो है
example_sentence.text_roman: bakro charāgāh mā̃ char rahiyo hai
example_sentence.translation_en: The he-goat is grazing in the pasture.
example_sentence.translation_hi: बकरा चरागाह में चर रहा है।
example_sentence.translation_ur: بکرا چراگاہ میں چر رہا ہے۔

definitions: Male goat, essential pastoral asset of nomadic Gujjar-Bakerwals.
Female goat kept for milk and wool.

entries.meaning_en: summer pasture settlement, highland meadow hut
entries.meaning_ur: موسم گرما کی چراگاہی بستی، ڈھوک

example_sentence.text: اسی گرمیاں ماں ڈھوک پر جاواں گا
example_sentence.text_devanagari: असी गर्मियाँ माँ ढोक पर जावांगा
example_sentence.text_roman: asī̃ garmiyā̃ mā̃ ḍhok par jāvāṅgā
example_sentence.translation_en: We will go to the highland summer pasture during summer.
example_sentence.translation_hi: हम गर्मियों में पहाड़ी ढोक पर जाएँगे।
example_sentence.translation_ur: ہم گرمیوں میں ڈھوک پر جائیں گے۔

entries.notes: Key cultural term of pastoral transhumance among Gujjars and Bakerwals.
definitions: High-altitude seasonal pastoral settlement or hut in alpine grazing meadows.

entries.meaning_en: nomadic camp, household settlement, family unit

example_sentence.translation_en: Our camp is by the riverbank.
example_sentence.translation_hi: हमारा डेरा नदी के किनारे है।

entries.notes: Denotes both physical shelter and extended pastoral kinship unit.
definitions: Nomadic encampment, tent, or the extended kinship household on migration.
Water, vital natural resource in highland pastures.

example_sentence.translation_en: Pleasant sunlight has come out today.

entries.notes: Common human designation in northern dialects.

example_sentence.translation_en: I have to go to the market.

definitions: To go, move from one place to another.

example_sentence.translation_en: You come to our house tomorrow.

example_sentence.text: پاݨی پیوݨو صحت واسطے چنگو ہے
example_sentence.text_devanagari: पाणी पीवणो सेहत वास्ते चंगो है
example_sentence.text_roman: pāṇi pīvṇo sehat vāste chaṅgo hai
example_sentence.translation_en: Drinking water is good for health.
example_sentence.translation_hi: पानी पीना सेहत के लिए अच्छा है।
example_sentence.translation_ur: پانی پینا صحت کے لیے اچھا ہے۔

entries.notes: Masculine adjective in -o, agrees with masculine head.

example_sentence.translation_en: There is a big tree on the mountain.

entries.notes: Ergative case marker in perfective transitive constructions.
definitions: Agentive case postposition governing transitive subject in perfective aspect.

example_sentence.translation_en: Give the book to the boy.

entries.notes: Dative marker following oblique noun chhore.

example_sentence.translation_en: There is water in the house.

entries.notes: Agrees with head noun in gender/number: ro (m.sg), ra (m.pl), ri (f).

example_sentence.text: دو بکری چراگاہ ماں چر رہیاں ہیں
example_sentence.text_devanagari: दो बकरी चरागाह माँ चर रहियाँ हैं
example_sentence.text_roman: do bakri charāgāh mā̃ char rahiyā̃ haiñ
example_sentence.translation_en: Two goats are grazing in the pasture.
example_sentence.translation_hi: दो बकरियाँ चरागाह में चर रही हैं।
example_sentence.translation_ur: دو بکریاں چراگاہ میں چر رہی ہیں۔

example_sentence.translation_en: I will come after three days.

entries.notes: Temporal adverb with past/future tense auxiliary differentiation.

example_sentence.translation_en: Snow has fallen on the mountain.
My sister is reading a book.

example_sentence.text: بھیڈاں چراگاہ ماں چر رہیاں ہیں
example_sentence.text_devanagari: बेडाँ चरागाह माँ चर रहियाँ हैं
example_sentence.text_roman: bheḍā̃ charāgāh mā̃ char rahiyā̃ haiñ
example_sentence.translation_en: The sheep are grazing in the pasture.
example_sentence.translation_hi: भेड़ें चरागाह में चर रही हैं।
example_sentence.translation_ur: بھیڑیں چراگاہ میں چر رہی ہیں۔

example_sentence.translation_en: The buffalo gives plenty of milk.

definitions: Milk from cows, buffaloes, or goats.
Butter churned from curd or milk in traditional wooden vessels.

example_sentence.text: ٹھنڈی لسی صحت بخش ہووے ہے
example_sentence.text_devanagari: ठंडी लस्सी सेहत बख़्श होवे है
example_sentence.text_roman: ṭhaṇḍī lassī sehat bakhsh hove hai
example_sentence.translation_ur: ٹھنڈی لسی صحت بخش ہوتی ہے۔

example_sentence.translation_en: There are many trees in the forest.
example_sentence.translation_hi: जंगल में बहुत सारे पेड़ हैं।
example_sentence.translation_ur: جنگل میں بہت سارے درخت ہیں۔

example_sentence.text: اس ری اکھ ماں پیڑ ہے
example_sentence.text_devanagari: उस री अक्ख माँ पीड़ है
example_sentence.text_roman: us rī akkh mā̃ pīṛ hai
example_sentence.translation_en: There is pain in his/her eye.
example_sentence.translation_ur: اس کی آنکھ میں درد ہے۔

example_sentence.text: میری گل کن لا کے سُوݨو
example_sentence.text_devanagari: मेरी गल्ल कन्न ला के सुणो
example_sentence.text_roman: merī gall kann lā ke suṇo
example_sentence.translation_en: Listen to my words with attentive ears.
example_sentence.translation_hi: मेरी बात ध्यान से कान लगाकर सुनो।
example_sentence.translation_ur: میری بات کان لگا کر سنو۔

example_sentence.translation_en: The weather on the mountain is cold.
